comment: Every function of the identity, tenancy, audit and util schemas as migrated at 5d8904b (origin/main, the P4 closure), dumped with pg_get_functiondef from a database built from that commit's migrations alone. The P5 lock-order guard's baseline control runs against these (P5 plan §7.2, R34). Regenerating it is never needed: these definitions do not change.

functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION identity.accept_totp_step(p_identity_id uuid, p_step bigint)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE identity.totp_credentials SET last_used_step = p_step
   WHERE identity_id = p_identity_id AND confirmed_at IS NOT NULL
     AND (last_used_step IS NULL OR last_used_step < p_step);
  RETURN FOUND;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION identity.active_membership(p_identity_id uuid, p_audience text, p_membership_id uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT pm.id FROM identity.platform_memberships pm
   WHERE p_audience = 'platform' AND pm.id = p_membership_id AND pm.identity_id = p_identity_id AND pm.status = 'active'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT mm.id FROM tenancy.merchant_memberships mm
    JOIN tenancy.merchants m ON m.id = mm.merchant_id AND m.status = 'active'
   WHERE mm.id = p_membership_id AND mm.identity_id = p_identity_id AND mm.status = 'active'
     AND ((p_audience = 'merchant' AND mm.kind IN ('owner', 'staff')) OR (p_audience = 'agent' AND mm.kind = 'agent'))
  LIMIT 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION identity.apply_new_password(p_identity_id uuid, p_password_hash text, p_reason text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE identity.identities
     SET password_hash = p_password_hash, password_changed_at = now(), updated_at = now()
   WHERE id = p_identity_id;
  UPDATE identity.sessions SET revoked_at = now(), revoke_reason = p_reason
   WHERE identity_id = p_identity_id AND revoked_at IS NULL;
END
$function$

functions.name: begin_totp_enrollment
functions.args: p_identity_id uuid, p_secret_ciphertext bytea, p_secret_key_id text
functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION identity.begin_totp_enrollment(p_identity_id uuid, p_secret_ciphertext bytea, p_secret_key_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM identity.totp_credentials t WHERE t.identity_id = p_identity_id AND t.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL) THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO identity.totp_credentials (identity_id, secret_ciphertext, secret_key_id)
  VALUES (p_identity_id, p_secret_ciphertext, p_secret_key_id)
  ON CONFLICT (identity_id) DO UPDATE
    SET secret_ciphertext = EXCLUDED.secret_ciphertext, secret_key_id = EXCLUDED.secret_key_id,
        last_used_step = NULL, created_at = now();
  RETURN true;
END
$function$

functions.args: p_identity_id uuid, p_platform_membership_id uuid, p_token_hash text

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION identity.create_mfa_challenge(p_identity_id uuid, p_platform_membership_id uuid, p_token_hash text)
 RETURNS timestamp with time zone
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_expires timestamptz := now() + interval '5 minutes';
BEGIN
  IF identity.active_membership(p_identity_id, 'platform', p_platform_membership_id) IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'no active platform membership' USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO identity.mfa_challenges (identity_id, platform_membership_id, token_hash, expires_at)
  VALUES (p_identity_id, p_platform_membership_id, p_token_hash, v_expires);
  RETURN v_expires;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION identity.eligible_memberships(p_identity_id uuid, p_audience text)
 RETURNS TABLE(membership_id uuid, merchant_id uuid, merchant_name text, kind text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT x.membership_id, x.merchant_id, x.merchant_name, x.kind
    FROM identity.identities i
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT pm.id AS membership_id, NULL::uuid AS merchant_id, NULL::text AS merchant_name, pm.role AS kind
        FROM identity.platform_memberships pm
       WHERE p_audience = 'platform' AND pm.identity_id = i.id AND pm.status = 'active' AND pm.role = 'super_admin'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT mm.id, m.id, m.name, mm.kind
        FROM tenancy.merchant_memberships mm
        JOIN tenancy.merchants m ON m.id = mm.merchant_id AND m.status = 'active'
       WHERE mm.identity_id = i.id AND mm.status = 'active'
         AND ((p_audience = 'merchant' AND mm.kind IN ('owner', 'staff')) OR (p_audience = 'agent' AND mm.kind = 'agent'))
    ) x
   WHERE i.id = p_identity_id AND i.status = 'active'
   ORDER BY x.merchant_name NULLS FIRST, x.membership_id;
$function$

 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION identity.validate_session(p_session_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(identity_id uuid, audience text, membership_id uuid, merchant_id uuid, scope text, kind text, role_id uuid, branch_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT s.identity_id, s.audience, coalesce(s.platform_membership_id, s.merchant_membership_id), mm.merchant_id,
         s.scope,
         coalesce(mm.kind, pm.role), mm.role_id, mm.branch_id
    FROM identity.sessions s
    JOIN identity.identities i ON i.id = s.identity_id AND i.status = 'active'
    LEFT JOIN tenancy.merchant_memberships mm ON mm.id = s.merchant_membership_id
    LEFT JOIN identity.platform_memberships pm ON pm.id = s.platform_membership_id
   WHERE s.id = p_session_id
     AND s.revoked_at IS NULL
     AND s.absolute_expires_at > now()
     AND identity.active_membership(s.identity_id, s.audience, coalesce(s.platform_membership_id, s.merchant_membership_id)) IS NOT NULL;
$function$

functions.name: verify_email
functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION identity.verify_email(p_token_hash text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_identity uuid := identity.consume_one_time_token('email_verification', p_token_hash);
BEGIN
  IF v_identity IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;
  UPDATE identity.identities SET email_verified_at = coalesce(email_verified_at, now()), updated_at = now()
   WHERE id = v_identity;
  -- BR-2.2: a business is real once its owner confirms the email.
  UPDATE tenancy.merchants m SET status = 'active', updated_at = now()
   WHERE m.status = 'pending_verification'
     AND m.id IN (SELECT mm.merchant_id FROM tenancy.merchant_memberships mm
                   WHERE mm.identity_id = v_identity AND mm.kind = 'owner');
  RETURN v_identity;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION tenancy.list_members(p_session_id uuid, p_membership_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(membership_id uuid, kind text, status text, role_id uuid, branch_id uuid, email text, created_at timestamp with time zone, deactivated_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT mm.id, mm.kind, mm.status, mm.role_id, mm.branch_id, i.email, mm.created_at, mm.deactivated_at
    FROM identity.validate_session(p_session_id) v
    JOIN tenancy.merchant_memberships mm ON mm.merchant_id = v.merchant_id
    JOIN identity.identities i ON i.id = mm.identity_id
   WHERE v.audience = 'merchant' AND v.scope = 'full' AND v.kind = 'owner'
     AND (p_membership_id IS NULL OR mm.id = p_membership_id)
   ORDER BY mm.created_at, mm.id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION tenancy.merchant_keeps_one_owner()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM tenancy.merchant_memberships WHERE merchant_id = OLD.merchant_id AND kind = 'owner'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'merchant % would have no owner (ADR-15 T17: transfer ownership instead)', OLD.merchant_id
      USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
  END IF;
  RETURN NULL;
END
$function$

functions.name: uuid_v7
functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION util.uuid_v7()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 PARALLEL SAFE
AS $function$
  SELECT encode(
    set_bit(
      set_bit(
        overlay(uuid_send(gen_random_uuid())
                PLACING substring(int8send(floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()) * 1000)::bigint) FROM 3)
                FROM 1 FOR 6),
        52, 1),
      53, 1),
    'hex')::uuid;
$function$
